manual.title: Manual Camera Setup & Instructions
manual.description:
### 🔓 Camera Setup Instructions

Configure your Chuangmi / Xiaomi camera parameters to enable **low-latency WebRTC live streaming** and local controls without cloud throttling.

*(✨ If your camera is already registered in Home Assistant or Xiaomi Miot, detected parameters have been pre-filled automatically below).* 

---
#### 📖 Parameter Guide & Useful Links:
- **Device ID (DID):** Unique numeric identifier of your camera in Xiaomi Cloud (9 to 10 digits).
- **Local IP:** Local network IP address assigned by your router (e.g. `192.168.1.50`). Required for fast stream routing and zero-latency local controls.
- **Token (32 hex):** 32-character miIO encryption token required for direct local UDP control of privacy mode, blue status LED, and night vision.
  - 🔗 **How to get your Token and DID?** If you don't have them, extract them easily using the open-source tool: [Xiaomi Cloud Tokens Extractor (GitHub)](https://github.com/PiotrMachowski/Xiaomi-cloud-tokens-extractor).
- **Model:** Hardware model identifier (e.g. `chuangmi.camera.ipc019e`).

data_description.camera_did: Numeric identifier of the camera in Xiaomi Cloud (e.g. 123456789).
data_description.camera_ip: Local IP address on your home network (e.g. 192.168.1.50).
data_description.camera_token: 32-character hexadecimal key for local UDP control.

init.title: Chuangmi Liberator & Coexistence Configuration
init.description: Configure dedicated ports and coexistence settings with your primary go2rtc service. Ports are automatically checked to ensure they are free.

data.enable_primary_bridge: Enable automatic bridge to Primary go2rtc

data_description.api_port: Port used by the isolated daemon for API calls. Ports 1984, 8554, and 8555 are protected for your primary go2rtc.
data_description.rtsp_port: Port used by the isolated daemon for local RTSP streams.
data_description.webrtc_port: Port used by the isolated daemon for WebRTC signalling.
data_description.enable_primary_bridge: Automatically register Chuangmi cameras into your primary go2rtc on port 1984 so they appear seamlessly in your main Web UI and cards.
data_description.primary_go2rtc_url: Base URL of your primary go2rtc (default: http://127.0.0.1:1984).
data_description.log_level: Logging verbosity of the background go2rtc instance.

error.port_reserved_primary: Ports 1984, 8554, and 8555 are reserved for your primary go2rtc to prevent collisions.
error.ports_must_be_distinct: API, RTSP, and WebRTC ports must be different from each other.
